description: WAF custom rules (Free: 5). The Cloudflare Free Managed Ruleset is on by default. Bot Fight Mode stays off: no rule can skip it and it would block webhooks and the uptime probe (§2).

rules.description: Webhooks (signed by RevenueCat, Stripe, Meta): no edge rate limit, Browser Integrity Check or Security Level
Sitemaps are served to verified bots only (§6)
Paths that only vulnerability scanners request (no PHP, no dotfiles except /.well-known/)
rules.expression: ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.well-known/")) or http.request.uri.path contains "/cgi-bin/"

rules.description: HTTP methods the application never serves
